speaker: Sunita
text: Hello, Ramesh ji bol rahe hain? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, Sharma ji ne aapka number diya tha.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Haan ji madam, namaste. Boliye, kya kaam hai?

speaker: Sunita
text: Mujhe apna flat paint karwana hai. Two BHK hai, Indirapuram mein, third floor pe.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony ki grill bhi karni hai?

speaker: Sunita
text: Andar ka poora, dono bedroom, hall aur kitchen. Balcony ki grill bhi kar dena.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Paint kaun sa lagwana hai? Asian Paints ka Royale loge ya normal Tractor Emulsion?

speaker: Sunita
text: Royale thoda costly padega. Aap Tractor Emulsion hi lagao, lekin do coat hone chahiye.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Do coat aur putty ka touch-up, material ke saath pachees hazaar lagega madam.

speaker: Sunita
text: Pachees hazaar bahut zyada hai. Mera budget twenty thousand ka hai.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Madam bees mein nahi ho payega, labour hi teen aadmi ka hai. Chalo baees hazaar final kar lo.

speaker: Sunita
text: Theek hai, twenty two thousand done. Lekin material aapka hoga, upar se koi extra charge nahi.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Haan theek hai.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Advance kitna doge madam? Material lene ke liye paanch hazaar toh pehle chahiye.

speaker: Sunita
text: Paanch hazaar advance main kal GPay kar dungi. UPI pe aapka yahi number hai na?

speaker: Ramesh
text: Ji haan, isi number pe kar dena. Ramesh Kumar naam aayega.

speaker: Sunita
text: Aur balance seventeen thousand kaam poora hone ke baad, same day de dungi.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Madam aadha kaam hone pe thoda de dena, saat hazaar. Baaki das hazaar last mein.

speaker: Sunita
text: Chalo theek hai. Kaam kab se start karoge?

speaker: Ramesh
text: Agle somvaar se shuru kar denge, subah nau baje tak pahunch jayenge.

speaker: Sunita
text: Aur khatam kab tak hoga? 15 tareekh ko mere ghar pe guests aa rahe hain.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Paanch din ka kaam hai madam. Shukravaar tak finish, pandrah tareekh se pehle ho jayega.

speaker: Sunita
text: Pakka?

speaker: Ramesh
text: Pakka.

speaker: Sunita
text: Toh final: total baees hazaar, paanch advance, saat beech mein, aur das kaam ke baad. Somvaar ko milte hain.
